body:
Expose typed table/column values from a library and accept caller composition at query boundaries. Keep application-only joins and filters in the application. This preserves compile-time expression compatibility without creating imports between packages that own unrelated tables.

Evidence: ds:block?id=project-purpose-7mzq92jv; ds:block?id=column-declaration-gthk6bb2. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Export columns; let callers compose
